**Issue #5007 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #5007: Patch: deal-screen the AI's attack-hook price, which the smoke gate reads the same at 0 and 0.5
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Once per decision the AI fires each unit's `when this attacks` and `after this attacks` text, Frenzy included, on a sandbox copy and prices what the attack gives its controller. A unit's worth counts half of that price (`attack_hook` 0.5), a starting guess from R2688000 that no deal screen has ever measured. Once built, the share becomes what paired games say it is, so attack-text units are traded, developed and answered at a measured price instead of a guessed one.

## Why

- [config.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/src/config.rs) (R2688000) calls `attack_hook` an `untuned start` and records only smoke-gate reads: 20, 20 and 20 of 20 at 0.5 and the identical 20, 20 and 20 at 0. The gate cannot tell them apart, and [SPEC §9.9](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md) says strength claims need hundreds of fresh deals, not the gate. No deal screen is recorded, unlike the neighboring probe shares.
- Concrete cards whose value rides entirely on this probe: Frenzy attackers such as Tmack Trav (Stinkyscape #94, Rush Frenzy), and the Wasp, Space Invader and Lantern Distiller evolutions that run through their own turn or attack text (R4648000). `has_attack_hook` in [evaluate.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs) names Frenzy alongside the hooks.
- The probe spend (`AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`, 24 nodes) is already paid every decision; only the priced share is unmeasured. `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` stays 0 as the frozen yardstick.

## Proposal

- One deal screen exactly as [training/improve.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/improve.md) (A screen) prescribes: build a control from the tip, then screen `attack_hook` at 1.0 against the 0.5 control (one change, 400 games on improve-dev, size fixed in advance). Keep it only if `edgeLow` is above 0, otherwise revert per R4319000, and record the tally in the `AI_EVAL` comment.
- Hold the kept value with extended scenes in [attack_hooks.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs) that fail without it; never weaken an existing scene. Leave `GREEDY_EVAL` at 0. Re-record the practice-claim fixture with the change, since decisions change.
- If the screen is inconclusive, close it out with the screen recorded; it then joins the scene-test-settled knobs per R4319000.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` only.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`: scenes pinning the kept value.
- `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json`: re-recorded with the change.
- No spec change (a number, not a rule) and no ruling.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deal screen run on improve-dev with its control commit and tally recorded in the config comment.
- [ ] Kept value has `edgeLow` above 0, or the knob is reverted with the inconclusive screen recorded.
- [ ] New or extended `attack_hooks.rs` scenes fail without the kept value.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) still clears its floors.
- [ ] The practice-claim fixture is re-recorded with the change and its tests pass.

## Size and risks

Medium work, difficulty hard (AI tuning): one 400-game deal screen plus config and scene tests. Main risk is an inconclusive screen, the usual outcome for a share the smoke gate reads identically; then the knob is reverted and only the recording remains. No fork screen is needed or proposed, per #4448's lesson that fork screens do not fit bot runs.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45760008051)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Deal-screen `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` from 0.5 to 1.0 on 400 paired games exactly as `training/improve.md` section "A screen" prescribes. Keep 1.0 only when the tally's `edgeLow` is above 0; otherwise revert to 0.5 and record the screen as inconclusive or reverted per R4319000. Hold the kept value with new decision-level scenes in `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` that fail without it, leave `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` at 0, and re-record the practice-claim fixture since decisions change. No spec change and no ruling: this is a number, not a rule.

## Files to touch

| Path | New or change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` 0.5 to 1.0 (only if kept); extend its doc comment with the screen tally |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` | change | New `r2688000_*` scenes pinning the kept value at decision level |
| `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json` | change | Re-recorded with `claim.test.ts` after the kept change |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` (harness-owned); `spec/` and `spec/rulings/` (no spec change, no ruling per the issue); `GREEDY_EVAL` in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`; `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`, `AI_SEARCH`, budgets, and any probe code in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` and `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`; `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/server/` code (fixture only). Governing sections: `SPEC §9.9` Evaluation paragraph (attack-hook sentence), `spec/rulings/R2688000.md`, `spec/rulings/R4319000.md`, `spec/rulings/R4811000.md`, `training/improve.md` "A screen".

## Steps

1. Read `training/improve.md` "A screen", `crates/ai/src/config.rs` lines 601-604 and 833-835, `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` functions `has_attack_hook`, `attack_hook_price`, `attack_hook_prices`, `unit_worth`, and `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` helpers `board`, `priced`, `prices_of`, `price_of`, `close` before changing anything.
2. Build the control from the committed tip with no other change: run `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools` then `cp target/release/jackioh ~/control-jackioh`. Record the tip commit hash for the comment.
3. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, set `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` from `0.5` to `1.0`. Change nothing else, including `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` (stays `0.0`) and `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES` (stays `24`).
4. Run one deal screen, decided in advance at 400 games: `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:~/control-jackioh --set improve-dev`. Do not extend it, do not re-screen, do not test other arms. Note `edgeLow`, `edgeHigh`, `wonBoth`/`lostBoth`, `decided`, `diverged`, and `inconclusive` from the closing tally.
5. Apply the keep rule: keep 1.0 only if `edgeLow` is above 0. If `edgeLow` is 0 or below, or the tally prints `inconclusive: true` (fewer than `SCREEN_MIN_DECIDED` 20 decided deals per R4319000), revert the knob to `0.5`. Never keep a screen early and never keep on a near miss.
6. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, extend the existing `attack_hook` doc comment (lines 833-835) with the screen in the file's own style, for example: `#5007: 400 games on improve-dev against the control at <tip-hash>, read <a>-<b>, edge <e> (<low> to <high>); <d> decided of 200 (won <w>, lost <l>), <n> diverged, every game clean: kept` (or `reverted`, or `inconclusive (R4319000): <d> decided of 200 ...; its scene tests settle it`). Keep the old smoke-gate sentence. Follow the `strike_back_survival_read` and `#4931` comment pattern.
7. If kept, add two decision-level scenes to `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` using its existing helpers and cards (`WASP` stinkyscape-091, `BADGER` stinkyscape-075, `HONEY_BADGER` stinkyscape-076, `TMACK` stinkyscape-094, `MENACE` core-019, `VANILLA` core-008, `POLYMORPH` meditative-024). Copy the shape of `r2688000_given_one_removal_the_ai_polymorphs_the_wasp`: build a `board()`, find the AI card id, call `play_ai_turn` or `decide` with `create_rng`, assert the chosen action. Scene A: own Honey Badger (Rush plus Badger text) against an enemy board where attacking trades the Badger for a kill plus the Resource — assert at 1.0 the AI attacks with the Badger first rather than standing it down or playing a vanilla line. Scene B: Tmack Trav (Frenzy, counted as an attack hook per R3551004) against a 9/9 Taunt plus a vanilla body — assert at 1.0 the AI prices the Frenzy re-attack and takes the line that develops or removes toward it, where at 0.5 it does not. Name both `r2688000_...` (no new ruling exists). If reverted, add no scenes and skip to step 9.
8. Verify each new scene fails without the kept value: temporarily set `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` back to `0.5` and to `0.0`, run the two tests, confirm each fails, then restore `1.0`. Never weaken an existing scene; the file's `r2688000_a_zero_weight_reads_no_price` test already pins `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook == 0.0` and must keep passing untouched.
9. Re-record the practice-claim fixture only if the knob changed value or decisions changed: run `JACKIOH_RECORD_PRACTICE_CLAIM=1 pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`, then confirm the diff touches only `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json` and commit that file's new content as part of the change. If the screen reverted (knob still 0.5), still re-run the claim test without recording and only record if it fails.
10. Run the checks: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai attack_hooks`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh gate`, `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`, and the server test `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r1303002_r2560000_the_game_the_worker_played_folds_and_pays`.

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, `r2688000_at_1_the_ai_attacks_with_the_honey_badger_for_the_resource`: Honey Badger against a kill-trade board; asserts `play_ai_turn`'s first attack action is the Badger's attack. Fails at 0.5 and 0.0. Run with `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit attack_hooks`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, `r2688000_at_1_the_ai_plays_toward_tmack_travs_frenzy_reattack`: Tmack Trav against a Taunt plus vanilla body; asserts `decide` picks the line that keeps or develops toward the Frenzy re-attack at 1.0. Fails at 0.5 and 0.0. Same command.
- Existing `r2688000_a_zero_weight_reads_no_price` (untouched): still asserts prices read nothing at weight 0 and `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook == 0.0`.
- `apps/web/src/practice/claim.test.ts`, `R1303002 the worker plays the claim fixture move for move`: re-recorded, then green via `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs`, `r1303002_r2560000_the_game_the_worker_played_folds_and_pays`: green after re-record via `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r1303002_r2560000`.
- `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke): still clears its floors with no new failures.

## Done when

- [ ] Deal screen run on improve-dev from a tip-built control, with control hash and tally (`edgeLow`, decided, diverged) recorded in the `attack_hook` comment.
- [ ] Kept value has `edgeLow` above 0, or the knob is reverted to 0.5 with the inconclusive or losing screen recorded.
- [ ] New or extended `attack_hooks.rs` scenes fail without the kept value (checked at 0.5 and 0.0); no existing scene weakened.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` is still 0 and probe code is untouched.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, and fmt are green; smoke gate clears its floors.
- [ ] Practice-claim fixture re-recorded with the change and its server test green.
- [ ] No spec file, ruling note, or forbidden path changed.

## Risks

- Inconclusive screen (the likely outcome: smoke reads 0 and 0.5 identically, so attack text rarely decides a deal). Avoid by accepting it: revert, record decided/diverged counts, let scene tests settle it per R4319000.
- Scene tests that pass at both values prove nothing. Avoid by checking each new test fails at 0.5 and 0.0 before finishing.
- Fixture churn hiding a real AI regression. Avoid by re-recording only through `claim.test.ts`, inspecting the fixture diff, and running both the web and server claim tests.
- Node-budget overrun from heavier attack-hook reliance. Avoid by changing the share only; probe nodes and budgets stay fixed, and the existing budget test (`r2688000_the_probes_stay_within_their_cap_and_the_decision_within_its_budget`) must stay green.

## Open questions

None. The screen kind (deal, 400 games, keep iff `edgeLow > 0`), the knob, the files, and the revert rule are all settled by the issue and `training/improve.md`.
```
